issues.description: Field Developer.monthsOfSwiftExperience: the problem statement (and the template) specify monthsOfSwiftExperience as Int? but the solution implements monthsOfSwiftExperience as Double?. This mismatch across artifacts can confuse students about the intended type to use, and which implementation to follow when writing the initializer, the switch comparison, and the attend(course:) increment logic.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the type across all artifacts. Recommended: change the solution to use Int? for monthsOfSwiftExperience (update the property declaration and initializer parameter to Int?), change the switch/case to compare Int values, and ensure attend(course:) increments the Int value (or sets it to 1) accordingly. Alternatively, if fractional months are intended, update the problem statement and template to specify Double? and adjust examples and comparisons to use Double consistently.
